highlights:
# Graphon Labs

Graphon Labs is a Software Development company. Graphon is a multimodal memory for AI that finds and connects meaningful moments, people, places, and things across videos, images, and text, and turns them into context, so AI can actually work. Graphon Labs employs 19 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, and India.

...

Graphon works differently. It reads the content itself: the frames, the speech and the pages, not just the file names and labels around them. As it reads, it builds an ontology of your data automatically, roughly 10x deeper than a team could build by hand. The result is a lasting memory of how everything connects, across formats and over time. AI can then reason across all of it, and every answer shows where it came from.

...

Graphon was founded in 2025 by Arbaaz Khan (CEO), Clark Zhang (CTO) and Deepak Mishra (COO), and is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. We've raised $8.3M to build it.
